page_title: JUV 1-0 LAZ | Juventus v Lazio 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Pedro (Lazio) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+4' Matias Vecino (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Luca Sacchi had an easy-decision to make.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted now, Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90' The referee is firm and issues Douglas Luiz (Juventus) a deserved yellow card.
87' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

87' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed towards the left post, but it was an easy job for the keeper to make a save. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
85' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Mario Gila (Lazio), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the left post of his own goal.

84' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) sees an opportunity to score and unleashes a powerful first-time rocket of a shot from long range. Ivan Provedel has a clear sight of the shot and pulls off a comfortable save to block the effort, which was directed to the middle of the goal.
81' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) serves up a nice cross, but Ivan Provedel punches the ball away.

81' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Ivan Provedel was alert and the score remains the same.
80' Juan Cabal (Juventus) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
78' Here comes a substitution. Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is brought on as a substitute for Nuno Tavares.
78' Danilo lays the ball off to Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z.
76' What a chance that is! Douglas Luiz (Juventus) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header narrowly wide of the right post.
76' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
75' Timothy Weah (Juventus) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
74' Timothy Weah (Juventus) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
73' Pedro (Lazio) tackles a bit over-zealously and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Juventus.
73' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Federico Gatti and he is replaced by Danilo (Juventus).
72' It is time for a substitution. Vasilije Adzic (Juventus) is on for Khephren Thuram.
72' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:2. 0:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
70' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is penalised for holding. Juan Luca Sacchi signals a set piece.
68' Andrea Cambiaso plays a short lofted pass to Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), whose header from the centre of the box drifts well past the left post.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Pedro (Lazio) is replacing Gustav Isaksen.
67' Substitution. Mattia Zaccagni will be replaced by Gaetano Castrovilli (Lazio).
66' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matias Vecino (Lazio) replacing Matteo Guendouzi.
66' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Timothy Weah. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
64' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Ivan Provedel comes off his line to gather the ball.
62' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
60' Timothy Weah (Juventus) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. It's a throw-in for Lazio.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) was quite harsh and Juan Luca Sacchi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' Timothy Weah swings the cross over. Douglas Luiz (Juventus) gets his head to it but it goes just wide of the left post.
57' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) takes the corner kick, but Ivan Provedel reads it well and stops the effort.
57' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
57' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) hits the crossbar with a rebound from near the penalty spot.
54' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Nicolo Savona is replaced by Timothy Weah (Juventus).
54' Substitution. Manuel Locatelli walks off the pitch and Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) comes on as a substitute.
54' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
53' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Juventus was in an offside position.
51' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
50' Nicolo Savona (Juventus) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
47' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
45+2' Juan Luca Sacchi shows a yellow card to Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
45+1' Juan Cabal (Juventus) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

45' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Juan Luca Sacchi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
45' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
43' Andrea Cambiaso beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Federico Gatti (Juventus), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
43' A dangerous looking corner kick from Douglas Luiz (Juventus) is cleared to safety by the defence.
42' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. Juventus have a corner.
41' Manuel Locatelli beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), who smashes a first-time shot well wide of the right post.

38' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
37' Now Juventus have a corner.
36' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The linesman makes the right call and Juventus will have a corner.
35' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dusan Vlahovic, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
33' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) tries to find Kenan Yildiz, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
32' An attempted cross from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is cleared.
29' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus).
29' The total number of attempts is 2:1. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:1.
27' The manager is forced to make a substitution due to a red card. Marco Baroni issues instructions to Patric (Lazio), who will replace Boulaye Dia.
26' A decent effort by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
24' Juventus are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
24' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and it’s RED for Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio).
23' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio)! Let's see what he decides.

21' A big opportunity is wasted by Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Michele Di Gregorio pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
20' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
18' Juan Cabal (Juventus) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
17' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Juan Luca Sacchi blows for a foul.
13' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Federico Gatti (Juventus). Juan Luca Sacchi saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Lazio get a free kick.
12' Federico Gatti (Juventus) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
12' Douglas Luiz (Juventus) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

12' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
9' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) plays a one-two with Adam Marusic, but the move breaks down.
8' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
7' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

7' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Juventus can continue in their attacking effort.
5' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michele Di Gregorio, who smothers the ball.
3' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) commits a rough foul. Juan Luca Sacchi stops the game and makes a call.
2' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
2' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Juventus are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
